title: 二十四节气
source: 二十四节气是中国古人根据太阳位置的变化总结出来的时间知识体系。它把一年分为二十四个时段，每个节气各有名称，如立春、清明、夏至和冬至。两千多年来，节气一直指导着农民安排播种、收获等农事活动。人们还根据节气调整饮食和作息，形成了许多习俗。2016年，二十四节气被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。如今，越来越多的年轻人开始关注节气，借此更好地了解自然和传统文化。
reference: The 24 solar terms are a system of knowledge about time that ancient Chinese people developed based on changes in the position of the sun. The system divides a year into 24 periods, each with its own name, such as the Beginning of Spring, Pure Brightness, the Summer Solstice and the Winter Solstice. For more than 2,000 years, the solar terms have guided farmers in arranging farming activities such as sowing and harvesting. People also adjust their diet and daily routines according to the solar terms, which has given rise to many customs. In 2016, the 24 solar terms were inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. Today, a growing number of young people have begun to pay attention to the solar terms, using them to better understand nature and traditional culture.
keywords: 人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录
the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity

title: 中国高铁
source: 近年来，中国的高速铁路发展迅速，已经成为人们出行的重要选择。高铁不仅速度快、准时，而且乘坐舒适、安全可靠。过去需要坐一整天火车才能到达的城市，如今只需几个小时就能抵达。高铁的发展大大缩短了城市之间的距离，促进了沿线地区的经济发展和旅游业的繁荣。许多人选择在一个城市工作，而在另一个城市生活。此外，网上购票和刷身份证进站等服务也让出行更加便捷。高铁正在改变中国人的生活方式。
reference: In recent years, China's high-speed railway has developed rapidly and has become an important choice for people when they travel. High-speed trains are not only fast and punctual, but also comfortable, safe and reliable. Cities that used to take a whole day to reach by train can now be reached in just a few hours. The development of high-speed rail has greatly shortened the distance between cities and promoted economic development and the prosperity of tourism in the areas along the lines. Many people choose to work in one city while living in another. In addition, services such as online ticket booking and entering stations with just an ID card have made travel more convenient. High-speed rail is changing the way Chinese people live.
keywords: 缩短了城市之间的距离

title: 中秋节
source: 中秋节在每年农历八月十五，是中国重要的传统节日之一。这天的月亮被认为是一年中最圆、最亮的，象征着团圆。因此，无论离家多远，人们都会尽量回家团聚。晚上，一家人常常坐在一起，一边赏月，一边吃月饼。月饼是中秋节的传统食品，口味多样。关于中秋节，还流传着许多美丽的传说，其中最有名的是嫦娥奔月。如今，中秋节已成为法定假日，人们也会通过视频通话或发送祝福与远方的亲友分享节日的快乐。
reference: The Mid-Autumn Festival, which falls on the 15th day of the eighth month of the Chinese lunar calendar, is one of China's important traditional festivals. The moon on this day is believed to be the roundest and brightest of the year, and it symbolizes reunion. Therefore, no matter how far away from home they are, people will try their best to return home for a family reunion. In the evening, family members often sit together, admiring the moon while eating mooncakes. Mooncakes, the traditional food of the festival, come in a wide variety of flavors. There are also many beautiful legends about the festival, the most famous of which is the story of Chang'e flying to the moon. Today, the Mid-Autumn Festival has become a public holiday, and people also share the joy of the festival with relatives and friends far away by making video calls or sending greetings.
keywords: the 15th day of the eighth lunar month

title: 丝绸之路
source: 丝绸之路是古代连接中国与中亚、西亚乃至欧洲和非洲的贸易通道。西汉时期，张骞奉命出使西域，为开辟这条通道奠定了基础。此后，中国的丝绸、瓷器和茶叶经由这条路线源源不断地运往西方，而葡萄、核桃等作物以及音乐、宗教也传入了中国。丝绸之路不仅是一条贸易之路，更是一座文化交流的桥梁，促进了沿线各国在经济、科技、艺术等领域的相互了解与共同发展。2013年，中国提出了“一带一路”倡议，旨在借鉴丝绸之路的历史经验，加强与沿线国家的合作，实现互利共赢。如今，这一倡议已得到许多国家的积极响应。
reference: The Silk Road was an ancient trade route linking China with Central Asia, West Asia and even Europe and Africa. During the Western Han Dynasty, Zhang Qian was sent as an envoy to the Western Regions, which laid the foundation for opening up this route. From then on, China's silk, porcelain and tea were transported to the West along this route in a steady stream, while crops such as grapes and walnuts, as well as music and religions, were introduced into China. The Silk Road was not only a road of trade but also a bridge of cultural exchange, promoting mutual understanding and common development among the countries along it in such fields as the economy, science and technology, and the arts. In 2013, China put forward the Belt and Road Initiative, which aims to draw on the historical experience of the Silk Road, strengthen cooperation with the countries along the route and achieve mutual benefit. Today, the initiative has received an active response from many countries.
keywords: be sent as an envoy to the Western Regions

title: 移动支付
source: 近年来，移动支付在中国迅速普及，深刻改变了人们的消费习惯。无论是在商场购物，还是在街边小摊买早餐，人们只需用手机扫码，几秒钟内就能完成付款。许多人出门已不再带现金和银行卡。移动支付的发展不仅为消费者提供了便利，也帮助大量小商户降低了经营成本，提高了效率。它还推动了网上购物、外卖、共享出行等新兴产业的发展，为经济增长注入了新活力。然而，移动支付也带来了一些问题，例如个人信息泄露和网络诈骗。专家指出，政府应进一步完善相关法律法规，加强监管，用户也应提高安全意识。
reference: In recent years, mobile payment has rapidly become widespread in China, profoundly changing people's spending habits. Whether shopping in a mall or buying breakfast at a street stall, people only need to scan a QR code with their mobile phones to complete a payment within seconds. Many people no longer carry cash or bank cards when they go out. The development of mobile payment has not only brought convenience to consumers, but also helped a large number of small businesses cut their operating costs and improve efficiency. It has also boosted the growth of emerging industries such as online shopping, food delivery and ride-sharing, injecting new vitality into economic growth. However, mobile payment has brought about some problems as well, such as personal information leaks and online fraud. Experts point out that the government should further improve relevant laws and regulations and strengthen supervision, while users should raise their awareness of security.

title: 植树造林
source: 植树造林是中国保护生态环境的一项重要举措。1979年，中国将每年3月12日定为植树节，鼓励全社会参与植树。几十年来，从城市到乡村，人们种下了大量树木。在北方一些曾经风沙肆虐的地区，经过几代人的不懈努力，大片荒漠变为绿洲。森林面积的扩大不仅改善了空气质量，减少了水土流失，还为野生动物提供了栖息地。一些地方还因地制宜发展林业和生态旅游，帮助当地居民增收，实现了生态保护与经济发展的良性循环。如今，“绿水青山就是金山银山”的理念已深入人心，越来越多的人自觉投身于美丽中国建设。
reference: Afforestation is an important measure that China has taken to protect its ecological environment. In 1979, China designated March 12 as Tree Planting Day, encouraging the whole of society to take part in planting trees. Over the past few decades, people have planted huge numbers of trees, from cities to the countryside. In some northern regions once ravaged by sandstorms, vast stretches of desert have been turned into oases through the unremitting efforts of several generations. The expansion of forests has not only improved air quality and reduced soil erosion, but also provided habitats for wildlife. Some places have also developed forestry and eco-tourism in light of local conditions, helping local residents increase their incomes and creating a virtuous circle between ecological protection and economic development. Today, the idea that "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets" has taken root in people's minds, and more and more people are voluntarily devoting themselves to building a beautiful China.
keywords: 绿水青山就是金山银山
lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets
